learning_outcomes.text: Adequate knowledge of mathematics, science and related engineering discipline-specific subjects; Ability to use theoretical and applied knowledge in these fields in complex engineering problems.

Ability to select and use modern techniques and tools necessary for the analysis and solution of complex problems encountered in engineering applications; Ability to use information technologies effectively.
Ability to design experiments, conduct experiments, collect data, analyze and interpret results to examine complex engineering problems or discipline-specific research issues.
Ability to work effectively on interdisciplinary teams.
Ability to communicate effectively verbally and in writing; knowledge of at least one foreign language; writing effective reports and understanding written reports.
Knowledge of standards used in engineering practices.
